name: Mumpillar
ability: Pharaoh's Curse (its own: once per battle, survives a knockout at half health with +2 Attack and Sp. Atk) / Torrent (hidden)
look: a caterpillar swaddled in bandages like a little mummy, with a black visor face, two big round glowing yellow eyes, a bandage curl on its head and blue-patched bandaged segments on stubby black feet
entry: It wraps itself in strips of silk soaked in river water and never takes them off. Old tales say anyone who unwraps one is cursed, and that it cannot be finished off: struck down, it rises again angrier than before.
how: A CobbleEffort starter: pick it at the starter screen (the CobbleEffort page, with Coalarva).
Wild: very rare in deserts next to water (an oasis).
